name: Send branded overdue-invoice statements from Xero with PDFMint

parameters.content:
## Branded overdue-invoice statements from Xero

One PDF per customer, covering every overdue invoice in your own layout. Add Xero, PDFMint and Gmail credentials, then edit **Your company details**.

### 2 · Xero
Fetches authorised sales invoices that still have an amount due.

### 3 · Branding
Set your company name, address, accent colour and footer once.

### 4 · Grouping
Keeps overdue balances and builds one statement per customer.

### 5 · Guard
Stops cleanly when there is nothing overdue.

### 6 · PDF
Renders the branded statement and names the file for the customer.

### 7 · Delivery
Emails the statement to the address stored on the Xero contact.
